paper.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

result.summary: 本文提出检索增强生成（RAG）模型，将预训练参数记忆（BART）与非参数记忆（Wikipedia 稠密向量索引，通过 DPR 检索）结合，并端到端微调 [S1.p2]。作者比较了 RAG-Sequence 和 RAG-Token 两种形式，前者对整个生成序列使用同一检索文档，后者可为每个 token 使用不同文档 [S2.p2]。在多个知识密集型任务上，RAG 在三个开放域问答任务上取得当时最优结果，并优于参数化 seq2seq 模型和任务特定的检索-抽取架构 [abstract]。在语言生成任务上，RAG 生成的文本比纯参数化 BART 基线更具体、多样且符合事实 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在解决预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上访问和精确操作知识能力有限、性能落后于任务特定架构的问题，以及为其决策提供来源和更新世界知识的问题 [abstract]。作者指出，结合参数记忆与非参数记忆的混合模型可以解决部分问题，因为知识可以直接修订和扩展，访问的知识可以被检查和解释 [S1.p1]。此前结合掩码语言模型与可微检索器的模型仅探索了开放域抽取式问答，本文希望将混合参数与非参数记忆引入序列到序列模型 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
Additionally, providing provenance for their decisions and updating their world knowledge remain open research problems.

Hybrid models that combine parametric memory with non-parametric (i.e., retrieval-based) memories can address some of these issues because knowledge can be directly revised and expanded, and accessed knowledge can be inspected and interpreted.

REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
Here, we bring hybrid parametric and non-parametric memory to the “workhorse of NLP,” i.e. sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) models.

method.text: RAG 模型使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。模型包含两个组件：返回 top-K 文本段落分布的检索器 p_η(z|x)，以及基于前 i-1 个 token、原始输入和检索段落生成当前 token 的生成器 p_θ(y_i|x,z,y_{1:i-1}) [S2.p1]。检索器基于 DPR 的双编码器架构，使用 BERT_BASE 文档编码器和查询编码器，通过最大内积搜索（MIPS）近似求解 top-k [S2.SS2.p1]。生成器使用 BART-large，将输入与检索内容拼接 [S2.SS3.p1]。训练时联合训练检索器和生成器，无需对检索文档的直接监督，固定文档编码器和索引，仅微调查询编码器和 BART 生成器 [S2.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
a retriever $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ with parameters $\eta$ that returns (top-K truncated) distributions over text passages given a query $x$

a generator $p_{\theta}(y_{i}|x,z,y_{1:i-1})$ parametrized by $\theta$ that generates a current token based on a context of the previous $i-1$ tokens $y_{1:i-1}$, the original input $x$ and a retrieved passage $z$
The retrieval component $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ is based on DPR. DPR follows a bi-encoder architecture
Calculating $\text{top-k}(p_{\eta}(\cdot|x))$, the list of $k$ documents $z$ with highest prior probability $p_{\eta}(z|x)$, is a Maximum Inner Product Search (MIPS) problem
We use BART-large, a pre-trained seq2seq transformer with 400M parameters. To combine the input $x$ with the retrieved content $z$ when generating from BART, we simply concatenate them.
We jointly train the retriever and generator components without any direct supervision on what document should be retrieved.
We do not find this step necessary for strong performance, and keep the document encoder (and index) fixed, only fine-tuning the query encoder $\text{BERT}_{q}$ and the BART generator.

experiments.text: 实验使用 2018 年 12 月的 Wikipedia dump 作为非参数知识源，每篇文章切分为不重叠的 100 词块，共 2100 万文档，使用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引 [S3.p1]。训练时检索 top k 文档，k 取 5 或 10，测试时的 k 由开发集确定 [S3.p1]。评估任务包括开放域问答（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）[S3.SS1.p1]、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG v2.1）[S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
Each Wikipedia article is split into disjoint 100-word chunks, to make a total of 21M documents.
We use the document encoder to compute an embedding for each document, and build a single MIPS index using FAISS with a Hierarchical Navigable Small World approximation for fast retrieval.
We consider $k\in\{5,10\}$ for training and set $k$ for test time using dev data.
We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
To test RAG’s natural language generation (NLG) in a knowledge-intensive setting, we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
To evaluate RAG’s generation abilities in a non-QA setting, we study open-domain question generation.
FEVER requires classifying whether a natural language claim is supported or refuted by Wikipedia, or whether there is not enough information to decide.

findings.text: 在四个开放域问答任务上，RAG 均取得新的最优结果（TriviaQA 仅在 T5 可比划分上）[S4.SS1.p1]。RAG 无需重排序器或抽取式阅读器即可达到最优性能 [S4.SS1.p1]。在 MS-MARCO NLG 上，RAG-Sequence 比 BART 高 2.6 Bleu 点和 2.6 Rouge-L 点 [S4.SS2.p1]。在 Jeopardy 问题生成上，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，两者均优于 BART 的 Q-BLEU-1 [S4.SS3.p1]。人类评估中，仅 7.1% 的案例认为 BART 比 RAG 更符合事实，而 42.7% 的案例认为 RAG 更符合事实 [S4.SS3.p1]。在 FEVER 三分类上，RAG 与最优模型差距在 4.3% 以内 [S4.SS4.p1]。RAG 的生成比 BART 更多样 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1]。通过替换非参数记忆索引，可以更新 RAG 的世界知识 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

evidence.quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
RAG demonstrates that neither a re-ranker nor extractive reader is necessary for state-of-the-art performance.
RAG-Sequence outperforms BART on Open MS-MARCO NLG by 2.6 Bleu points and 2.6 Rouge-L points.
RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
Evaluators indicated that BART was more factual than RAG in only 7.1% of cases, while RAG was more factual in 42.7% of cases
For 3-way classification, RAG scores are within 4.3% of state-of-the-art models
RAG-Sequence’s generations are more diverse than RAG-Token’s, and both are significantly more diverse than BART without needing any diversity-promoting decoding.
This shows we can update RAG’s world knowledge by simply replacing its non-parametric memory.

limitations.text: 作者指出，在初步实验中，对于故事生成等任务，检索组件会“崩溃”并学会检索相同的文档，此时生成器学会忽略文档，RAG 模型表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。FEVER 的另一个子任务涉及从 Wikipedia 抽取句子作为支持分类预测的证据，但由于 FEVER 使用了不同的 Wikipedia dump，直接处理该任务并不简单，作者希望在未来工作中解决 [A5.p1]。作者还提到，未来工作可以研究是否能用类似 BART 的去噪目标或其他目标从头联合预训练两个组件 [S6.p1]。

evidence.quote: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
In these cases, once retrieval had collapsed, the generator would learn to ignore the documents, and the RAG model would perform equivalently to BART.
As FEVER uses a different Wikipedia dump to us, directly tackling this task is not straightforward. We hope to address this in future work.
In future work, it may be fruitful to investigate if the two components can be jointly pre-trained from scratch, either with a denoising objective similar to BART or some another objective.
